Dave Matthews Band
June 4, 2022
Credit One Stadium
Charleston, South Carolina

Taper: Mark Terrell, linked up with John Gortakowski
Location: Right side FOH (Stage Left), 8' (below the video camera height from the 100s) w/ umbrella on stand
Source: Schoeps MK4s > Actives > Babynbox > Tascam DR-05X (24/48)
Lineage: WAV > Audacity 2.3.2 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

02. You Might Die Trying

06. One Sweet World

08. Granny
09. Walk Around the Moon
10. She
11. The Space Between
12. So Much to Say >
13. Anyone Seen the Bridge >
14. Too Much
15. Samurai Cop (Oh Joy Begin)
16. Jimi Thing
17. Break for It
18. Tripping Billies
19. Come On Come On
20. Dancing Nancies >
21. Warehouse
22. Encore Break
23. Rye Whiskey
24. Two Step

Dave Matthews Band:
Dave Matthews - Guitar, Lead Vocals
Tim Reynolds - Electric Guitar
Stefan Lessard - Bass
Buddy Strong - Keyboards, Vocals
Rashawn Ross - Trumpet, Vocals
Jeff Coffin - Saxophone, Flute
Carter Beauford - Drums

Thank you to John Gortakowski for linking up to tape the show. Great weekend in Charleston and night 2 was
actually quite a bit better than night 1, although the original forecast said otherwise. We lucked out with
the weather at this one.
Thank you to Tommy from the DMB sound team for his constant support of the DMB taping scene.

Compiled by Mark Terrell on 2022/06/06.
